title: Source-first dashboard story inventory metrics
summary: This iteration carries the 154-entry collection inventory runtime projection into the first source story and source metrics dashboard, so readers see inventory total, known runtime coverage, inherited logical status, unreported logical-source mappings, and collection-only entries before the long inventory.

validation_commands: node --test --test-name-pattern "source metrics dashboard cards render operational metrics as cards|source-first dashboard exposes full inventory runtime metrics" tests/unit.test.js
node --test --test-name-pattern "source inventory|source-first runtime|source metrics dashboard|source-first IA|source signal story" tests/unit.test.js
Playwright screenshot check for #section-source-first-dashboard at 1280x900 and 390x1200

degraded_sections.message: The real 2026-06-29 page-check still reports the existing community_cards_reader_facing degraded check, but no blocking checks are present and this iteration does not modify community card rendering.

lessons.lesson: The full inventory runtime layer is only actionable when the first dashboard summarizes it before the reader reaches the long list.
lessons.evidence: The red unit test failed because the dashboard had only six logical-source cards and no full-inventory runtime metric; the green page-check records 11 dashboard cards including INVENTORY_TOTAL, RUNTIME_KNOWN, INHERITED_RUNTIME, UNREPORTED_RUNTIME, and COLLECTION_ONLY.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep the dashboard inventory metric gate whenever source-first public pages are regenerated.

lessons.lesson: A visible full inventory section is not enough to prove first-screen observability.
lessons.evidence: The red E2E removed only the dashboard inventory metric cards while leaving source story, status focus, map, and full inventory rows intact; old page-check still passed until the dashboard metric gate was added.
lessons.recommended_action: Page-check should continue validating both dashboard-level summary and row-level inventory runtime coverage.

lessons.lesson: Story and dashboard should share the same inventory projection but remain different surfaces.
lessons.evidence: The story remains four cards while its summary and lead card now mention full inventory coverage; the dashboard carries the detailed metric cards.
lessons.recommended_action: Do not expand the source story card count unless the user approves a layout change; put additional numeric detail into the dashboard.

followups.action: Continue the source-first roadmap by refining source group scan ergonomics or adding a compact first-viewport system health dashboard only if it can be gated without hiding the 154-entry inventory.
